lenses.decisionQuestion: Where is the system boundary, who/what is outside it, and which interfaces/lifecycle relations determine whole-system outcomes?
prerequisites: a system of interest can be named
contraindications: the domain-native boundary is already explicit and no whole-system ambiguity remains

lenses.decisionQuestion: Does the observed interaction structure support or contradict the current decomposition/module boundaries?
prerequisites: enough interaction evidence exists to build a meaningful dependency matrix/graph
contraindications: very sparse graph with no disputed boundary
similarity without dependency evidence

lenses.decisionQuestion: Which state, observations, controllers, delays, disturbances and feedback loops govern dynamic behavior?
prerequisites: behavior evolves over time and feedback can affect later state
contraindications: purely static structure with no meaningful feedback question

lenses.decisionQuestion: Can unacceptable loss arise from unsafe control or interaction even when components locally behave as designed?
prerequisites: an unacceptable loss or consequential system state can be defined
contraindications: generic low-consequence bug review with no system-level loss/control question

lenses.decisionQuestion: Can this component be composed or replaced without strengthening hidden assumptions or weakening required guarantees?
prerequisites: candidate components and required environment/guarantees can be stated
contraindications: no composition/replacement decision exists

lenses.sourceSubstrate: structural causal models / intervention and identifiability reasoning
lenses.decisionQuestion: Would intervening on X change Y under the stated causal assumptions, or is the effect not identified?
prerequisites: a causal estimand/intervention can be stated
contraindications: pure description with no causal or intervention claim

lenses.decisionQuestion: How do explicit failure modes propagate, or which credible cause paths produce a specified top failure?
prerequisites: functions/failure modes or a top undesired event can be bounded
contraindications: loss arises primarily from unsafe interaction with no component/process failure; prefer STPA

lenses.decisionQuestion: Can protected information influence an observation or sink that the intended observer should not see?
prerequisites: protected source and observer/sink can be stated
contraindications: the question is effect authority without information visibility; use authority/security/control methods instead

lenses.decisionQuestion: How should repeated trial budget be allocated among already-defined comparable options as feedback arrives?
contraindications: one-shot choice
heterogeneous open concept search
unstable or meaningless reward

lenses.decisionQuestion: How should concept space and knowledge space co-expand when the desired object/design is not yet known?
prerequisites: there is a genuine generative design question rather than only known-alternative optimization
contraindications: routine implementation
known comparable options where only allocation/selection remains

lenses.decisionQuestion: Can a bounded population be varied and selected using a trustworthy evaluator without Goodhart collapse?
prerequisites: evaluator is trustworthy for the bounded objective
contraindications: whole-product value is unobserved and fitness is only a convenient proxy
no stable candidate representation

lenses.decisionQuestion: How do semi-autonomous units coordinate, adapt, preserve identity and match environmental variety without false centralization?
prerequisites: an organizational system and environment can be bounded
contraindications: candidate-search problem with no organization/control-structure question
using VSM as a five-service template

lenses.sourceSubstrate: systems dynamics / deep-uncertainty decision / robustness synthesis
lenses.decisionQuestion: Has the governing regime changed upstream even though downstream levels lag, and what robust action survives uncertainty?
prerequisites: a candidate regime boundary and delayed/stock-flow mechanism can be stated
contraindications: ordinary stationary variation with no structural-change hypothesis

lenses.sourceSubstrate: security engineering composition over information flow, control/STPA, authority/effect/persistence analysis
lenses.decisionQuestion: Are identity, read/derive/network/persist/effect authority, controls, commit points and reconciliation aligned across an agentic capability?
prerequisites: an agentic capability or authority/data/effect pipeline can be bounded
contraindications: generic vulnerability checklist with no meaningful authority/data/effect boundary

reservePoolPolicy.purpose: Discovery coordinates for Lens Compiler only. Reserve entries are not routable active lenses.
reservePoolPolicy.activePromotionOwner: Lens Router registry admission after Lens Compiler evidence

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: game theory / repeated and imperfect-information games
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: When outcomes depend on other adaptive actors, what strategies, equilibria, best responses or exploitability properties matter?
requiredAssumptions: actors/actions/payoffs or preference relations can be bounded
strategic interdependence is material rather than metaphorical
reservePool.promotionTrigger: A real Ordivon decision cannot be resolved by existing lenses because counterparty adaptation/exploitability changes the recommended action.
reservePool.currentBlocker: No cross-domain prospective case has yet shown a distinct routing need beyond domain-native game-theoretic analysis.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: mechanism design / incentive compatibility / auction and allocation theory
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: Can rules be designed so individually motivated actors reveal/use information and choose actions that produce desired system outcomes?
requiredAssumptions: actors have strategically relevant private information or incentives
designer controls some rules/outcome mapping
reservePool.promotionTrigger: A project decision depends on designing rules against strategic manipulation, not merely coordinating fixed-role agents.
reservePool.currentBlocker: No prospective Ordivon case yet requires incentive-compatible rule design.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: queueing theory / stochastic service systems
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: When arrivals, waiting, service and finite capacity interact, what bottleneck/capacity behavior follows?
requiredAssumptions: bounded work/customer population can be defined
arrival/service/waiting measurements are available or can be collected
reservePool.promotionTrigger: Measured queueing/capacity behavior becomes a material architecture decision and the queueing model changes that decision.
reservePool.currentBlocker: Agent Service pilot lacks measured arrival/service/utilization/queue data and demonstrated saturation.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: operations research / mathematical optimization
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: How should scarce resources be allocated under explicit objectives, constraints and trade-offs?
requiredAssumptions: decision variables/objective/constraints can be stated without replacing unknown value with a weak proxy
reservePool.promotionTrigger: A bounded allocation/scheduling decision recurs and exact/approximate optimization gives unique decision value.
reservePool.currentBlocker: No single generic OR lens has yet shown value beyond domain-native optimization methods.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: decision analysis / Bayesian decision theory / expected utility and value of information
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: What action is preferred when consequences, uncertainty and information-acquisition costs are explicit?
requiredAssumptions: decision alternatives and relevant consequences can be represented
utility/preferences are not fabricated
reservePool.promotionTrigger: A recurring Ordivon decision needs explicit information-acquisition/value trade-offs beyond the Router's qualitative heuristic.
reservePool.currentBlocker: Current Router deliberately avoids fake quantitative VOI when utilities/probabilities are not defensible.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: network science / graph processes / diffusion and cascades
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: How do topology, centrality, communities, diffusion or cascades shape system-level behavior beyond pairwise dependency listing?
requiredAssumptions: graph semantics are meaningful
edge types/weights correspond to a real process
reservePool.promotionTrigger: A large-network phenomenon changes a decision in a way DSM/topological inspection alone cannot.
reservePool.currentBlocker: Current LEGO graphs have not yet required diffusion/cascade/network-process models.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: distributed systems / consensus / replication / fault models
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: What safety/liveness guarantees are achievable under specified crash, partition, timing and replication assumptions?
requiredAssumptions: fault/timing model is explicit
replicated state/operations are identified
reservePool.promotionTrigger: A cross-project decision repeatedly needs distributed-systems safety/liveness reasoning not adequately owned by a domain-native implementation review.
reservePool.currentBlocker: Most current Runtime/Host distributed questions already have direct distributed-systems engineering ownership.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: formal methods / model checking / theorem proving / refinement
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: Can critical invariants or temporal properties be proved/refuted over an explicit transition/specification model?
requiredAssumptions: formal state/specification can be bounded
property is precise enough to verify
reservePool.promotionTrigger: A repeated class of critical Ordivon invariants benefits from a reusable formal-verification lens rather than project-native proof tooling.
reservePool.currentBlocker: Formal verification is currently better treated as domain method unless a cross-domain reusable analysis contract emerges.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: static analysis / abstract interpretation / dynamic program analysis
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: What program behaviors, data/control flows or invariants can be inferred without executing every path?
requiredAssumptions: source/intermediate representation exists
analysis precision/soundness trade-off can be stated
reservePool.promotionTrigger: A cross-domain code-analysis task repeatedly needs a common reasoning adapter beyond existing security or project-native tooling.
reservePool.currentBlocker: Most such questions are currently best served by concrete language/security analysis tools.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: database theory / transactions / provenance / data dependencies
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: How do transactions, constraints, lineage and derivations determine data correctness and provenance across state transitions?
requiredAssumptions: data model and transaction semantics are explicit
reservePool.promotionTrigger: A reusable provenance/transaction decision recurs across domains and existing evidence graphs are insufficient.
reservePool.currentBlocker: Current projects usually have project-native DB/runtime ownership.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: information theory
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: How much information can a channel/representation carry or reveal under a defined probabilistic model?
requiredAssumptions: probability model/state space and measurable random variables are defined
reservePool.promotionTrigger: Quantitative information measures alter a real design/measurement decision beyond qualitative information-flow reasoning.
reservePool.currentBlocker: Most current uses would be metaphor-only because distributions/variables are not yet defined.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: metrology / measurement theory / uncertainty and calibration
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: What exactly is being measured, with what traceability, uncertainty, calibration and construct-to-observation mapping?
requiredAssumptions: a measurable quantity/construct and measurement process can be specified
reservePool.promotionTrigger: Cross-domain Ordivon evaluations repeatedly fail because measurement validity/calibration, not causal inference, is the dominant uncertainty.
reservePool.currentBlocker: Current projects handle measurement mostly within research/domain protocols.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: psychometrics / latent-variable measurement
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: How can latent human constructs be measured reliably and validly from imperfect observed responses?
requiredAssumptions: human latent construct is genuinely relevant
observational instrument/data can support psychometric analysis
reservePool.promotionTrigger: Research/Game/HCI decisions repeatedly depend on latent constructs that cannot be reduced to direct behavioral metrics.
reservePool.currentBlocker: No current cross-domain validated latent-variable use case.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: human-computer interaction / human factors / ergonomics
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: How do interface, workload, affordances, errors and human capabilities shape interaction outcomes?
requiredAssumptions: a human interaction/operator decision is material
appropriate user evidence can be gathered
reservePool.promotionTrigger: A cross-domain interaction/control question repeatedly requires HCI/human-factors methods beyond domain-native user research.
reservePool.currentBlocker: Human evidence remains domain-specific and should not be replaced by generic Agent analysis.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: cognitive science / cognitive psychology
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: Which memory, attention, learning, perception or mental-model constraints explain observed human behavior?
requiredAssumptions: human cognition is causal/relevant to the decision
constructs can be operationalized rather than guessed
reservePool.promotionTrigger: A real decision changes because a cognitive model predicts/diagnoses behavior beyond ordinary HCI observations.
reservePool.currentBlocker: High risk of speculative storytelling without direct human evidence.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: behavioral economics / judgment and decision research
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: How do empirically observed deviations from idealized rational-choice models affect incentives and decisions?
requiredAssumptions: human behavioral data/established effect is relevant
effect is not assumed from stereotype
reservePool.promotionTrigger: A prospective case demonstrates distinct behavioral-model value beyond direct experiments/user research.
reservePool.currentBlocker: Generic bias-labeling would add vocabulary without reliable decision value.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: sociology / institutional and social-structure analysis
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: How do norms, roles, institutions and social structure shape behavior beyond individual incentives and formal organization charts?
requiredAssumptions: social/institutional structure is material
claims can be grounded in evidence rather than analogy
reservePool.promotionTrigger: An organization/community case cannot be explained by formal control/authority alone and sociological structure changes the decision.
reservePool.currentBlocker: No prospectively validated cross-domain case yet.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: ecology / population and community dynamics
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: How do interacting populations, niches, resource limits and disturbances shape persistence, competition or coexistence?
requiredAssumptions: target truly contains population/resource interactions with defensible ecological mapping
reservePool.promotionTrigger: An actual multi-population/adaptive system requires ecological operators that change a decision.
reservePool.currentBlocker: Most software/organization analogies would be metaphor-only.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: epidemiology / contagion and compartment models
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: How does a transmissible state spread through a population/network under explicit contact and transition assumptions?
requiredAssumptions: a transmissible state and contact/transition process exist
compartment/network assumptions are evidenced
reservePool.promotionTrigger: A real propagation problem type-checks to contagion models and yields unique intervention guidance.
reservePool.currentBlocker: High metaphor risk outside genuine spread processes.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: statistical physics / phase transitions / interacting-particle models
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: Can macro behavior be derived from many interacting micro-units under a defined stochastic/mechanical ensemble?
requiredAssumptions: microstate/interaction/ensemble mapping is mathematically meaningful
reservePool.promotionTrigger: A cross-domain case supports a real micro-to-macro quantitative mapping and changes a decision.
reservePool.currentBlocker: Very high metaphor-only risk in organizational/software discussions.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: system identification / dynamical-systems inference
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: What dynamic model can be inferred from observed input-output/state trajectories when mechanisms are partly unknown?
requiredAssumptions: excitation/observations are sufficient to identify a useful model
model class/uncertainty can be stated
reservePool.promotionTrigger: A dynamic Ordivon system needs learned model structure/parameters before control or prediction decisions.
reservePool.currentBlocker: Current Control lens cases have not required model identification from telemetry.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: probabilistic forecasting / calibration and scoring rules
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: Are probabilistic predictions calibrated/discriminating enough to support decisions over time?
requiredAssumptions: repeated forecast-outcome pairs exist
probabilities are explicit
reservePool.promotionTrigger: Repeated Ordivon forecasting tasks need cross-domain calibration/evaluation rather than one-off narrative forecasts.
reservePool.currentBlocker: Current regime analysis emphasizes hypotheses/falsifiers rather than calibrated probability forecasting.

reservePool.sourceSubstrate: applied category theory / compositionality
reservePool.uniqueQuestion: Can system composition be represented with morphisms/interfaces so global structure follows systematically from local composition?
requiredAssumptions: objects/morphisms/composition laws correspond to real system semantics
reservePool.promotionTrigger: A real composition problem needs algebraic composition beyond assume-guarantee contracts and produces a unique decision/test.
reservePool.currentBlocker: Current contracts lens captures practical replaceability; categorical formalization has not yet added unique value.
